decisions.question: Which subject (cars, stations, price, trucks, buses) does a figure, tile or card belong to?
decisions.usedIn: key-figure tiles, V02, V04, V05, V07, V09, chapter accents
reasons: Variables nominales sin orden natural → colores cualitativos, no un gradiente.
Campo continuo o densidad variable → paleta continua.
Se preservan los colores de SCM9; se extraen muestras sin modificar sus tonos originales.
decisions.ownRule: Catalogue reduced to the colours that reach 3:1 on all three surfaces (card #292A4E, page #221E41, alt #20274C); 3 colour(s) of batlowS skipped before reaching 5: #011959 #215F61 #4C724D.
decisions.redundantCoding: Every category is also named in the chart (row label, legend or key); patterns mark states of the same variable.
decisions.status: proposed — pending visual validation with real users, colour-vision simulation and print

decisions.question: What is the state of a milestone or a claim?
decisions.variable: status (done · pending · plan · not confirmed · out of service)
decisions.usedIn: V06 timeline and legend, status chips, “not confirmed” chip, out-of-service stations
reasons: Color reservado a estados de interfaz y siempre acompañado de texto/icono; el dato cuantitativo no determina el tono.
decisions.redundantCoding: Text on every chip; marker shape in the timeline (filled · ring · dashed ring); hatching for the out-of-service stations.

validators.textContrast: Comprobación relativa solo al fondo indicado; pendiente en componentes reales.

decisions.question: Which marks need hierarchy but no meaning?
decisions.usedIn: first-half 2025 base bar (V02 C), target markers (V05, V09), “when” labels in What to watch
reasons: Un único tono neutro basta: el color no necesita codificar categorías ni magnitudes.
decisions.note: Missing data is written as a dash or ND with an explanation, never drawn as zero; the missing token exists for any future chart that needs a mark.

decisions.question: Did the figure rise or fall against the same period a year earlier?
decisions.type: ordered with a declared centre: 0 = no change
decisions.sampledAt: values −90 and +90 of a −100…+100 domain (5 % from each end); the size of the change is written in the chip, colour only gives the sign
reasons: Referencia central semántica conocida → escala divergente.
Campo continuo o densidad variable → paleta continua.
Se preservan los colores de SCM9; se extraen muestras sin modificar sus tonos originales.
Centre 0 is declared by the editor (no change): COL-03.
decisions.redundantCoding: The sign is written (+/−) and the size is a number; colour is never the only channel. No “green is good / red is bad”: a fall in sales and a fall in a price are not the same thing.
